action: Verify a Domain property for global.rentbikehanoi.com, submit https://global.rentbikehanoi.com/sitemap.xml, connect it in OpenSEO (project f8184d9f…).
expected_result: Coverage, indexed count, queries and CWV field data become measurable.
verification: OpenSEO list_search_console_sites shows the property; URL Inspection works for sample URLs.
done_criteria: Property verified, sitemap submitted and processed without errors; first coverage report stored in this workbook.

title: Locale Pillar does not yet target its market's researched commercial head term (e.g. 'thuê xe máy Hà Nội') in primary_query, title and H1
action: Owner directive 2026-10-28: /global competes independently for every commercial rental keyword in all 10 languages and yields no keyword to any domain. Research the head term per market (volume, variants, SERP intent); make it the Pillar primary_query; place it naturally in title, H1 and opening copy; give the Pillar commercial-investigation depth (how to choose a shop and a bike, what deposits, documents and checks to expect, links to the price/deposit, documents and safety Hubs); point Hubs/Supporting to the Pillar with descriptive anchors that contain the term; re-freeze only the changed fields.
expected_result: Each Pillar is /global's strongest page for its market's commercial head term, with matching title/H1/intent.
verification: S-PILLAR-HEAD-TERM absent in the re-audit; rank tracking/GSC once connected.
done_criteria: Head term recorded in data/seo/commercial-head-terms.json with evidence; Pillar primary_query/title/H1 contain it; seo-guard PASS; live QA PASS.

title: Third-party index shows 0 ranking keywords, Domain Authority 2, 37 backlinks from 32 domains

expected_result: Measured organic impressions and growing referring domains.
verification: GSC performance + backlink tool re-run monthly.
done_criteria: Baseline captured in GSC; referring domains trend recorded in AUDIT CHANGELOG.
